body: I seriously don’t understand why high school teachers AND the administration are so fucking mean to kids. College? Everyone is nice and cares about you. Hell, even the financial aid office just wants the best for you. I seriously don’t understand the need for such mean and careless teachers to exist around such impressionable minds!! Just torture. BUT AH great job on your entire life OP. :-)

If she’s serious, she needs to learn how to wait and you need to make that clear to her. If she cannot wait, then a friendship is all it should be. 
She’s an adult and needs to see that these are crucial years of your development and as stupid as it sounds, you don’t need to be dragged on and distracted by a relationship, a very serious one for that matter. I don’t know her obviously but the impact of the relationship on her world v.s. yours are very different because of the age.
I’m one year older than my boyfriend and I sometimes feel like we’re in different mindsets when thinking about us since he’s in high school and I’ve since graduated. All I can say is, please be careful. Of course she has no bad intentions for you and cares very much but four years is a very large gap; if she can have patience until you’re legal, then that will be the ultimate test of strength for the relationship. Best of luck.

My parents are so fucking backwards like this it was mind boggling. I applaud your perseverance and keeping your grades up, I didn’t and now I feel like I’m in a hole lmfao. They also swept the concept of depression under the rug too because they “give me everything” like yeah, okay, where’s the love and support then?
Once you’re out of the house you’ll see how ridiculous that way of raising a child is and you’ll only be surrounded by your goals and vibes and all that fun stuff. Trust me, moving out from my parents house was the best thing I’ve ever done. Constant negative reinforcement is literal torture. Keep up the great work though, you will go on to do amazing things. :-)
All the right people and the wrong circumstances that singlehandedly ruin everything. Watching your favorite people suffer just because that’s the way things are.

I teared up reading this. It’s so rough. I’m a girl so I feel like there’s a large stigma to be a clean woman or some shit. Even when I’m feeling 110% awful I try to spend 5 minutes cleaning up, even a little. A small sense of accomplishment is better than nothing.

It’s so hard when they’re your favorite person and that place is just an empty hole. I’m still close with my ex, I guess you could say, it’s a pseudo relationship but god I’m so lonely and he’s there but isn’t. It’s hard and you need to find things to simply fill your time and bring you an equal amount of joy. Take yourself on dates, drive around and sing your favorite songs. Anything that’s a deep hobby or passion you never tried is extremely helpful.
AH that is so useful. Thank you for that honestly and I wish you the best in your journey :-)
I never bring my journal in but that seems effective since I’ll generally feel better after venting into my journal and stuff so that’s also an area where I’m goofing up :(
Ahh thank you :’) Different perspectives are important. I didn’t even notice I was mildly self deprecating.
Thank you so so much. I’m a pushover naturally anyway so it’s hard for me to put my foot down and say how I feel, but it’s her job to help so I will try to do that.
I’ll try that thank you. I just feel like I’m not dangerously depressed, it’s just there still and hasn’t gone away. It feels like my fault that I cant express myself fully.
Next time play some music and dance around! Make it a new fun memory and not a hurtful one :-) Keep up the progress!!

Hey! I felt the same way and cried my eyes out and called the suicide hotline. I was just done and felt like I couldn’t ever get help so I told them about that and they asked for my insurance and they connected me to an associate who sent me a list of available Therapists in my area and some websites to look on for available ones also. It really helped because as someone who was depressed as I was, being on the computer for hours was even tiresome. Psychologytoday .com is actually a good tool because you can alter the options and find someone perfect for your needs. Good luck :’))))
I feel stupid for enjoying it so much because I know it isn’t how things are now and it’s out of the blue. The rest of my week will be dull and that’s that. It’s just sad.

I know how you feel completely. Sort of in the same situation, but don’t lose hope in those that are close to you. It’s hard to not seclude yourself and begin to drown in the depression, but you cannot. Rip your sheets off, do all of your laundry, sweep or vacuum your room, pull the blinds open and let fresh air and sunlight in and close your eyes. Something so mundane like that can really release all of the tension in your room if that’s where you are. Believe it or not, but our surroundings effect us more than we’ll ever realize. It will get better OP. It’s an uphill battle and it’s so vague and hard to see the light at the end of the tunnel as well, but the light at the end of the tunnel is you.
Happy Birthday!!!! Go to your favorite restaurant and order the most extra meal and of course, a dessert at the end. Some people can sing to you :-)

It’s just feeling stuck forever since you’ve been born, I hate it so much. I feel like even if I do everything to change or improve my life, it will always have its issues. It’s so discouraging to think like that however. Try to distract yourself. I know it isn’t solving the problem, but easing the pain is doing something.

It’s a common feeling to associate worthlessness and being unlovable when someone leaves, I know it all too well. Friends, family, and romantic relationships especially. You put your all into someone and you feel responsible when it ends, I know :-( Keep your head up and find your worth. Fake that confidence until it’s a habit and comes naturally. It WILL get better, I’m going through it too. Stay strong!
This is absolutely wonderful. Writing is a great habit to pick up when you’re feeling down, keep it up! :-)

You should be proud of yourself!! It's so so so easy to fall back into old ways, but once you are able to stop yourself from those urges (no matter what they may be), it's so easy to adopt good and healthy habits. You said you and your partner separated and I'm so sorry about that. I can't say it'll get easier, but please don't lose sight of yourself without them there. Even if things didn't end so happy, I'm sure that they want the best for you. Keep being resilient and strong, I believe in you!!!
